description: Exact 32-byte protocol-seed vectors for the promotion draw (spec section 4), one per Pool.cluster_domain. The LiteSVM close suite (solana/tests/financial-runtime, row protocol_seed_differs_between_devnet_and_mainnet_cluster_domains_and_matches_host_vector) builds a real round whose sealed preferred set is exactly the four candidates below, runs request_round_draw on the compiled program under each domain, and asserts the on-chain CloseRecord.protocol_seed and the ORAO request PDA equal these vectors. The same bytes are pinned by the program's own unit test through solana/fixtures/sampling.json (protocol_seed.vectors); both files were also recomputed independently with Python hashlib. The second domain is the devnet fixture domain pinned by sampling.json; a mainnet genesis writes its own 32 bytes, so a mainnet vector exists only once that domain is chosen.
rule: SHA256(seed_domain || cluster_domain_32 || program_id_32 || round_id_le || close_id_le || set_tag_u8 || selected_count_le || sealed_digest_32)
candidate_digest_rule: d0 = SHA256(candidates_domain || set_tag); d(i+1) = SHA256(d(i) || owner_32 || loss_le_16)
